ConversionSettings.description:
Converter settings; part of the identity of the digest they produce.

`Default` is a Rust convenience for a deployment's defaults, never a serde default: every
field is required on the wire.

ocr_language.description: Docling `ocr_lang`, such as `en` or `ch`; absent uses docling's default (`en`).

page_image_dpi.description:
Render resolution; docling `images_scale` = this / 72. At most 144, docling's own render
resolution: a higher scale only upsamples that render and adds no detail.

page_images.description: Keep a render of every page (docling `generate_page_images`).

table_structure.description: Reconstruct table structure with the model (docling `no_table_former` off).

IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen retry identity for one write, scoped to tenant, subject and operation.

oneOf.description: Recognise only regions with no embedded text layer (docling default).
Never run recognition; layout and tables are still detected (docling `skip_ocr`).
Recognise every page from its render (docling `force_full_page_ocr`).

UploadId.description: Identity of one authenticated source upload occurrence.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable application identity for one user-organized workspace.

description: Convert finalized uploads into source cards in the user-selected folder.

apply_naming_rules.description: Apply the explicit workspace conventions after preview acceptance.

base_revision.description: Exact revision on which this change is based; stale writes conflict.

destination.description: Relative destination folder; empty for root.

settings.description:
Converter settings; absent means the deployment's defaults, resolved into the job at
acceptance so a retry converts with the same settings.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose permissions and storage scope apply.
